definitions.positiveCase: One known analog site scored against one target listed in its analogFor. A site listed for several targets is split equally between them, so every site counts once in each number.
definitions.rocAuc: Share of (positive case, negative control) pairs, both scored against the same target, in which the known analog has the higher score. Ties count half. A site with no score counts as below every scored site. 0.5 is chance, 1.0 is perfect.
definitions.rocAucScoredOnly: The same, using only pairs where both sites have a score.
definitions.top10Share: Share of known analogs whose cell is in the top 10% of all scored Earth cells for their matching target. Unscored cases count as not in the top 10%.
definitions.meanPercentile: Mean share of scored Earth cells that a known analog beats or ties, over scored cases. 0.5 is chance. This compares known analogs with every land cell, a harder test than the negative controls.
definitions.snapping: Each site is scored at the nearest earth.json cell centre. Sites more than 60 km from any cell are unscored.
definitions.candidates: Indonesian candidate sites are never part of tuning or validation. Their scores are reported separately.
